page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors. It features 128 dedicated physical cores operating at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each of the 128 vCPUs maps directly to a physical core, eliminating hyperthreading resource sharing. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. It also lacks integrated GPU hardware accelerators. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

The dedicated core allocation and high vCPU density position this instance as a premium resource tier. It offers high compute density and predictable performance for workloads that do not tolerate hyperthreading latency. The 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio makes it suitable for large-scale general-purpose workloads, enterprise applications, distributed databases, and high-throughput web serving.
